Script fonts for the Signature Generator ("Type your signature").
All five are licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1; each font's licence,
with its copyright line and any Reserved Font Name, is in <name>-OFL.txt.

The .woff files are the original TrueType files from the Google Fonts
repository, wrapped in WOFF 1.0 with zlib compression only. Every font table is
byte-for-byte identical to the original and no WOFF metadata was added, so per
the OFL FAQ (question on WOFF versions) they are not Modified Versions and keep
their names. Conversion: fontTools TTFont(lazy=True, recalcBBoxes=False,
recalcTimestamp=False) saved with flavor "woff"; table data verified identical.

Original files (retrieved 2026-09-28), SHA-256 of the original .ttf:
  great-vibes.woff
    https://github.com/google/fonts/blob/main/ofl/greatvibes/GreatVibes-Regular.ttf
    sha256 8d509802186f1b51572531ecf313e8098f9a5bfdfaca93f0c9b34467f9982d15
  dancing-script.woff

Loaded only when the "Type" tab of the Signature Generator is opened.
